caption:
A loud pop-up with a phone number is a scam signal. 🚨

What to do: don't call, don't click, close the tab or the browser. If it won't close, restart your device.
Real companies don't show a phone number in a pop-up and demand you call now.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#cybersecurity #onlinesafety #scamalert #techsupportscam #popup #privacy #digitalsafety #staysafe #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Pop-up says your computer is infected. Call now?
scenes.say: A pop-up says your computer is infected, call now? Do not. It is a scam.

scenes.title: Stay calm and close it
items: Close the tab or the browser
scenes.say: Do not call the number. Do not click anything inside it. Close the tab, or close the browser.

scenes.myth: A loud warning means I must act fast.
scenes.fact: Panic and a deadline are how scammers work.
scenes.say: Myth. A loud warning means I must act fast. Fact. Panic and a deadline are how scammers work.

scenes.title: Real warnings don't say call us
scenes.body: Your browser and system will not ask you to phone a stranger.
scenes.say: Red flag. A real warning from your system will not ask you to phone a stranger.

scenes.title: Can't close it?
scenes.body: Restart your device, then run your normal security scan.
scenes.say: If you cannot close it, restart your device, then run your normal security scan.
